---
name: Bug report
about: A reproducible failure with redacted evidence
labels: bug
---

Describe the expected and observed behavior. Include the exact command, generic machine class and OS build, and a minimal reproduction. Do not paste credentials, private paths, account names, personal media or raw native handles.

State whether the case is a portable fixture, a hosted synthetic capture, or manual Discord acceptance. Attach only redacted results. A build or fixture pass is not native Windows acceptance.
